title: How Much Reduction Is Restored to an Auto Loans Rate on a Change of Draft Instruction
content:
The reduction restored to the rate on a loan of the Auto Loans line is read from the borrower's purchases on their Personal Credit Cards account over the last twelve months, together with the scheduled installments credited to the loan over the last twenty-four months.

| Card purchases over the last twelve months | Scheduled installments credited in the last twenty-four months | Reduction restored |
|---|---|---|
| At least 9000.00 USD | At least 24 | 0.1 points |
| At least 3000.00 USD, with either reading short of the row above | At least 15, with either reading short of the row above | 0.15 points |
| Any other reading | Any other reading | The automatic-payment reduction the product publishes |

The reduction restored is 0.1 points where the borrower's card purchases over the last twelve months total at least 9000.00 USD and at least 24 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twenty-four months.

It is 0.15 points where those purchases total at least 3000.00 USD and at least 15 scheduled installments have been credited to the loan in the last twenty-four months, while either those purchases fall short of 9000.00 USD or those installments fall short of 24.

It is the automatic-payment reduction the product publishes for every other borrower.

## The two windows are not the same window

The purchase reading looks back twelve months over the borrower's card account in the Personal Credit Cards line. The installment reading looks back twenty-four months over the auto loan. A borrower may be strong on one window and weak on the other.

## Readings that fall short on one window or the other

A borrower with 9000.00 USD of card purchases and 23 installments credited over twenty-four months takes 0.15 points, the installments falling short of 24 while both middle-row readings are met.

A borrower with 2999.99 USD of card purchases takes the reduction the product publishes, whatever their installment count.

A borrower with 14 installments credited over twenty-four months takes the reduction the product publishes, whatever their card purchases.
